Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies product marketing expertise at scale. About the Role 10x Team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are looking for knowledgeable product marketing managers based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered product marketing systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to product marketing strategy, go-to-market plans, messaging, and practical aspects of product positioning - Evaluate AI responses for product marketing soundness, technical accuracy, and compliance with real-world expectations - Draft realistic product marketing scenarios based on your direct professional experience - Create scenario variations from different perspectives (e.g. product marketing manager, product manager, client, or business leader) - Identify gaps, oversights, or weak reasoning in AI-generated product marketing content In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated content, ensuring it reflects authentic product marketing reasoning, business strategies, and real-world processes. Rather than conducting traditional product marketing work, you’ll apply your expertise to help AI systems understand and reason about go-to-market and positioning at scale. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Join us to help shape the product marketing expertise of the world’s most advanced AI models! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. angellist-angellist:lever:61594493-8045-.description: Why Join AngelList We’re solving some of the hardest problems in venture capital and private markets. You’ll work with a team that values precision, urgency, and long-term thinking. If you want to shape how startups are funded and built, this is the place. About AngelList We exist to accelerate innovation by increasing the number of successful startups in the world. We do this by building the financial infrastructure that makes it easier for more people to invest in world-changing companies. AngelList is the nexus of venture capital and the startup community. We support $171B+ in assets and have powered investments into over 13,000 startups—over 300 of which are unicorns. Today, 57% of top-tier U.S. VC deals involve investors on AngelList. While our scale is large, our ambition is larger. If you're excited to build the future of private markets, come build with us. About the Role: $200B+ in assets and $90B in money movement run on infrastructure that about 50 engineers and a growing number of agents build on top of. We're hiring a Head of Engineering, Foundations to lead the team that owns it. This role reports directly to the CEO and has company-level scope. Part of what this team owns is new. Agents are becoming first-class users of our own systems, and nobody has a settled answer for what a platform owes a non-human user: sandboxing, audit trails, rollback, all against systems that move real money. You'd be deciding how that works here. As a Head of Engineering here, you'd be expected to personally ship, not just direct.
responsibilities: Hire, coach, and grow a small team of high-performing engineers, and develop the staff and principal engineers who carry technical standards into other teams.
Build the platform the whole engineering org runs on: developer platforms, deployment pipelines, observability, and developer tooling.
Automate infrastructure as code on Kubernetes and AWS, using Pulumi, cdk8s, and ArgoCD.
Build the harnesses agents execute inside, including sandboxing, audit trails, and rollback against systems that move real money.
Set the engineering standards for reliability, operability, and architectural coherence, and sequence the quality work that keeps teams shipping quickly over time.

cic-cic:lever:47c2a02b-e453-4178-aceb-51.description: Accounting Manager Are you interested in fast-paced, energetic, collaborative environments? Are you interested in an organization where Accounting is considered as key strategic role for growth. If so,CIC Japan is seeking an Accounting Manager to strengthen its accounting function in a growing and dynamic environment. This role will oversee accounting operations across multiple Japan entities, manage a small team, and ensure the integrity of financial reporting and processes.The position will also support the development of scalable finance operations as the business expands across Asia.This position reports directly to the Finance Director Japan. Founded in 1999 in Cambridge, MA, CIC is one of the first companies to offer flexible office space and coworking options, providing a platform for the world’s most impactful entrepreneurs to innovate better and faster. We have locations in Boston, Cambridge, Philadelphia, Providence, Rotterdam, St. Louis, Warsaw, and Tokyo, and are growing into other cities. CIC Tokyo is centered on companies that aim to grow, and communities and services that are looking to accelerate their business growth and global expansion. Because of its influence in startup and innovation scenery, CIC Tokyo has frequent visits of VIPs such as Prime Minister Kishida, Governor Koike, and other business leaders in Japan. CIC Tokyo is now recognized as a prestigious center of new businesses and startups in Japan by business leaders in Japan. Learn more about us here. You think creatively and critically about problems and enjoy a fast-paced startup environment. cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:d13.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Position Overview As an Assistant Store Manager at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by assisting a high-performing retail team that inspires customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. The Assistant Store Manager helps cultivate a positive store culture focused on #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:7b.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. Replit is seeking a Business Development Representative (BDR) to be an early member of our sales team. This role will handle both inbound leads and outbound prospecting to build a robust pipeline for our Account Executives. Candidates with some technical experience (i.e., having basic coding knowledge or prior experience at developer tool companies) are ideal. This position plays a crucial role in our go-to-market strategy, identifying and qualifying potential customers across all segments from SMB to Enterprise. You'll be the first point of contact for many prospects, setting the tone for their Replit experience. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for technology and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: - Generate and qualify new sales opportunities through both inbound lead follow-up and outbound prospecting activities - Research target accounts and create personalized outreach strategies to engage potential customers - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era - Articulate Replit's value proposition and align it with customers' business challenges - Schedule and coordinate meetings between qualified prospects and Account Executives - Maintain accurate prospect data and activity logging in Replit's CRM (Hubspot) - Collaborate with marketing to provide feedback on lead quality and campaign effectiveness - Continuously refine outreach approaches based on performance data - Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly qualification quotas REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: - 1-2 years of experience in sales development, lead generation, or similar customer-facing role - Excellent written and verbal communication skills - Self-starter with strong organizational skills and attention to detail - Resilience and persistence in the face of rejection - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies - Experience with or willingness to learn CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Clay, SmartLead) - Strong listening skills and ability to identify customer pain points - Passion for technology and staying current with industry trends - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus NICE TO HAVE: - You're an active Replit user - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools - Basic understanding of software development or coding concepts - Experience with multi-channel prospecting (email, phone, social) - Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent practical experience) TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE: - Replit - SFDC - Outreach - Nooks - ZooomInfo - CommonRoom - Gong - LinkedIn SalesNav THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF: - You're not based in the London area - You have no interest in understanding the software development lifecycle or learning basic coding concepts - You're not passionate about AI - You prefer independent work with minimal client interaction - You're uncomfortable with a fast-paced startup environment where priorities may shift quickly Note: This role will begin as remote, with plans to transition to a hybrid model once we establish a local office presence. Full-Time Employee Benefits Include: 💰 Competitive Salary & Equity 💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only) ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance 🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability 🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave 🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays 🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only) 📱

Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:551b5cd9-6a0.title: Hydrus - Voice Contributor - English (US)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:551b5cd9-6a0.description: Description About the Project We're looking for native-level English (US) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project. The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio. Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment. What You'll Do Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions Your Recording Environment Three things are required, and each is judged separately: An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required — see below. A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail. A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording. Minimum Required Gear Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar. Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar. Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples – isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc… Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets. Technical Specification You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications: WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply — this level of technicality is required for this role. Who We're Looking For Native-level English (US) speaker A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc – anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio Commitment & Compensation Estimated time: approximately 8 hours total across two scheduled sessions Compensation: $48.00 USD per hour
